standard_prerequisites: rig-closed primes of Noetherian adic rings and the description of B/q as a Noetherian local ring of dimension 1 with its adic topology
adicity of the composite A -> B/q when varphi is adic
finite length of B/(q + varphi(a)) and the finiteness criterion for complete local rings (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-finite-over-complete-ring)
integrality implies surjectivity on spectra (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-integral-overring-surjective)

the residue field of a rig-closed point is finitely generated as an algebra over the residue field of the image (lemma-rig-closed-point-relative-residue-field of the same chapter, with lemma-finite-type-finite-type-red)
the Hilbert Nullstellensatz: a field finitely generated as an algebra over a subfield is a finite extension (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-field-finite-type-over-domain)
core_obligations: Prove that for an adic topologically finite type arrow varphi : A -> B of WAdm^Noeth, a rig-closed prime q of B with p its contraction and a the ideal of topologically nilpotent elements of A, the following are equivalent: (1) the residue field of B/q is finite over A/a; (2) p is rig-closed in A; (3) A/p is contained in B/q as a finite extension of rings
proof_roadmap: From (1): B/q is a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring with adic topology, A -> B/q is adic so varphi(a) is a nonzero ideal, whence B/(q + varphi(a)) has finite length and is finite over A/a; the complete-ring finiteness lemma makes B/q finite over A, giving (3).
From (3): finiteness makes B/q integral over A/p, so Spec(B/q) -> Spec(A/p) is surjective, which is exactly rig-closedness of p.

From (2): the residue field extension kappa/kappa' is finitely generated as an algebra by the residue-field lemma; the Nullstellensatz makes it a finite field extension, so the residue field of B/q is finite over A/a, giving (1).
difficulty_reason: H3: a three-way equivalence combining adic topology bookkeeping with the Nullstellensatz.
